name: Kettlebell Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
cues: Hold the kettlebell in the hand opposite your standing leg
Reach the free leg back as your torso tips forward in one line
Lower the bell along the inside of your standing shin
Press the standing foot down and bring your hips through to stand
